scope: Identity and presentation only, under the already pinned BLIND-GRADING-OPERATIONS-v1. No requirement, expected value, native fact, source byte, image byte, cause unit or denominator changes.

first_grade.source: Exact sealed production bytes in neutral relative namespaces, plus exact production placement and each relevant approved public/private bridge. Full source/PNG originals remain separately retained.
first_grade.contracts: Unchanged approved public/private plan, assertion catalog and source documents. Where a lock is projected, retain exact sources.*.document values; omit only original filename/path metadata that could disclose ownership.
first_grade.native_observation: Preserve every source native-observation field/value except the top-level operations cost breakdown and top-level issues alarm list (retained separately for phase two). Keep actual backend, environment, same-process/epoch bindings, native nodes, snapshot indices, actions, callbacks and coverage/terminal facts. No replacement values or expected-derived passes.
first_grade.automatic_actuals: A value-preserving projection of each original automatic.assertions row: id, actual and snapshot_indices when present. Omit status, reason, expected-derived verdicts, counts, machine_findings and failed-id selection. These measured actuals remain evidence to inspect, not independent quality verdicts.
first_grade.image_review: Original unchanged review catalog/rows and neutral observation identifiers. Exact original PNG bytes, native-relative paths and image SHA256 values; no resizing, recompression, crop, mask, blur or invented screenshot.
first_grade.no_alarms_or_identity: No tool/API/version, arm, cost, outer timing/resource record, config, cycle, source-root paths, worker self-claim, original arm-revealing paths or another judge result. Raw/worker alarm material is deferred until every first-pass cause seal exists.
first_grade.scope_limit: Missing native facts, incomplete full-content acquisition and unsupported visual conclusions stay unknown. Source or expected text does not substitute for images a judge has not actually inspected. Predeclared N/A remains separate.

provenance.operator_ledger: Outside every blind packet: original absolute path, exact file-byte SHA/bytes, neutral destination SHA/bytes, and exact JSON pointer selections/omissions. Preserve originals unchanged.
provenance.identity_audit: Before dispatch, reject textual packet members containing original arm/workspace paths or frozen tool/API identity. Any unsupported field requiring a projection change is an explicit pre-grade operational correction with the original attempt retained; never silently redact semantic/native values.
provenance.mapping: Separately pinned random X/Y-to-arm mapping stays unavailable to judges and matcher until all independent cause/alarm grades and common-cause/correspondence seals close.
provenance.review: Independent AI contexts, same configured parent model without override, own version only. Actual image-inspection ledger and source/native/contract citations required.

bindings: Independent graders provide original-fact source and manual-image observations for fresh private acquisitions. Frozen binding/evaluation uses independently adjudicated observations after cause/alarm seals; disagreements remain U. Public outcomes and public unresolved tasks are never rewritten or cleared.
timing: Retain the already pinned separate hidden-native, two-judge cause, later two-judge alarm and final-binding episodes. Common initial-oracle and global matching work are distinct from arm public clocks.
